snippet.title: PlayStation - Uki Uki Tsuri Tengoku - Kawa Monogatari (1998) - Intro
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Uki Uki Tsuri Tengoku: Kawa Monogatari is a Sports game, published by Teichiku Records, which was released in Japan in 1998.
